On February 15, Congressman Randy Fine took to X (formerly Twitter) to defend
dogs and offend Muslims. Fine
[posted](https://x.com/RepFine/status/2023161539897720931) that “If they force
us to choose, the choice between dogs and Muslims is not a difficult one.”

Where on earth did that come from?

Fine, a Republican representing Florida’s 6th Congressional District, was
reacting to a post from [Nerdeen
Kiswani](https://x.com/NerdeenKiswani/status/2022091365182845006). Kiswani is
the co-founder and chair of Within Our Lifetime, a Palestinian civil rights
group operating in New York City. On February 12, 2026, Kiswani posted that
“Finally, NYC is coming to Islam. Dogs definitely have a place in society,
just not as indoor pets. Like we’ve said all along, they are unclean.”[[1]]()

Kiswani immediately added two posts in which she claimed that she was kidding:

> “Lmao at the Zionists frothing at the mouth at this, thinking they’re doing
> something. It’s obviously a joke I don’t care if you have a dog, I do care
> if your dog is shitting everywhere and you’re not cleaning it.”

Fair enough. Kiswani added: “Also clearly trying to weigh in on an issue
unaware of the current nyc discourse where we’re collectively (jokingly)
hating on dogs given all the visible dog shit in the unmelted snow
lmao”[[2]]() She’s right. Kiswani’s posts were prompted by this Winter’s
record-setting levels of snowfall in the Northeast. Dog shit _is_ visible in
snow banks on New York City streets, as a
[photo](https://nypost.com/2026/02/13/us-news/anti-israel-activist-quips-dog-
poop-apocalypse-proves-why-nyc-should-turn-to-islam/) in the New York _Post_
shows. Kiswani was one of numberless New Yorkers joking (or swearing) about
it.

Kiswani was not calling for a ban on New Yorkers owning dogs as pets. But Fine
makes it sound like she was.

Even the uber-conservative [_New York Post_](https://nypost.com/2026/02/13/us-
news/anti-israel-activist-quips-dog-poop-apocalypse-proves-why-nyc-should-
turn-to-islam/) could tell that Kiswani was joking. The _Post_ ran a story
under the headline “Anti-Israel Activist _Quips_ Dog Poop Apocalypse Proves
Why NYC Should Turn to Islam” (my emphasis).

There the matter should have rested. It didn’t. No sooner did Kiswani’s posts
go up than the pile-on began. Commenters on Kiswani’s posts werent buying her
claim that she had been writing “jokingly.” Instead, Kiswani was accused of
backpedaling once she saw the outrage her posts had created. Other posts
vilified Muslims in the ugliest terms:

“You're damn right we have a problem with Muslims, AFTER 9-11……. [We don't
want you here.”](https://x.com/Catty1976se/status/2023610650648609265)  
“Islam is a CANCER on the world.”

“Personally, [I value my dog more than any
Muslim](https://x.com/turner_lis26460/status/2023828275722940443). My message
to you is GFY.”

“Dogs are way more loved and cherished than muzzies. Dogs are beautiful and
loyal. [Muzzies love death and
destruction.](https://x.com/MargoL90665488/status/2023869498047283225)” These
are not even the ugliest comments.

**Resign, Fine**

Fine’s February 15 tweet was met by renewed calls for his resignation or
censure. During his brief time in Congress (Fine won his seat in a 2025
special election) Fine has compiled a long rap sheet of Islamophobic remarks.

Last year, during an appearance on FoxNews, Fine made a statement which
arguably called for the [use of nuclear weapons in
Gaza](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/06/11/did-a-florida-congressman-call-
for-nuking-gaza/). Fine denies that that is what he meant. During the same
interview, Fine, who is Jewish, said that [“The Palestinian cause is an evil
one.”](https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=730873099526102) He has smeared two
of his House colleagues, Representatives Rashida Tlaib and Ilhan Omar, as
“terrorists.”

Fine supports the [expulsion of all
Muslims](https://x.com/RepFine/status/2000585809477374227) from the US, even
if they are US citizens: “Mainstream Muslims have declared war on us. The
least we can do is kick them the hell out of America.”

On February 20, 2026, Fine introduced in the House the [Protecting Puppies
from Sharia Act](https://fine.house.gov/uploadedfiles/finefl_089_xml.pdf). I
wish I were kidding. The bill prohibits any state or locality which bans
owning dogs as pets from receiving federal funds. Has any unit of government
in the US tried to outlaw dogs as pets, or more broadly, tried to legislate
Sharia? Not as far as I can tell. Fine’s bill is yet another example of
Republicans coming up with solutions to nonexistent problems while ignoring
real problems like making healthcare affordable.

Fine has announced that he is bringing two guests to Tuesday’s State of the
Union address. One is the Congressman’s father. The other is Sadie: his
father’s seeing-eye dog.

**Notes.**

[[1]]() Most Muslims regard dogs as ritually unclean, but deserving of
“kindness and compassion.” The ahadith (the recorded sayings and deeds of the
[Prophet Muhammad](https://www.whyislam.org/dogs/)) describe acts of kindness
the Prophet bestowed on dogs and other animals.

[[2]]() A 1981 Grammy Award-winning song by Kim Carnes describes a woman as
[“pure as New York
snow.”](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EPOIS5taqA8&list=RDEPOIS5taqA8&start_radio=1)
Has Carnes ever been to New York?
